description: This file defines the `SagemakerLLM` class, which implements methods for interacting with Amazon SageMaker endpoints, including text completion and embedding functionalities. It manages credentials, prepares requests, handles both synchronous and asynchronous calls, and includes detailed logging. The class supports streaming responses and integrates with various utilities for request transformation and response parsing.
